a15.fee.placeholder: Leave blank to auto-estimate from fee rates
a15.fee.hint_div: Fees are not estimated for dividends: blank is recorded as 0. If your broker actually charged a fee, enter the real amount.
a15.price.hint: Must be above 0, up to 3 decimal places.
a15.err.qty: Quantity must be a positive whole number: not 0, negative, fractional or containing letters.
a15.err.qty_max: Quantity is above the limit (100 million).
a15.err.price: Price must be a number above 0 with at most 3 decimal places, no sign or letters.
a15.err.fee: Fees must be a number of 0 or more with at most 2 decimal places; leave it blank if you do not want to enter it.
a15.err.fee_over: Fees cannot exceed the trade amount (quantity × price).
a15.lot.generic: Buys are in lots of 100 shares (100 units for ETFs); STAR Market stocks (starting with 688) need at least 200 shares.
a15.lot.buy: Buys are in lots of 100 shares (100 units for ETFs): the quantity must be a multiple of 100.
a15.lot.star: STAR Market stocks (starting with 688 / 689): buy at least 200 shares, then in steps of 1 share.
a15.lot.sell: Sells have no lot rule; enter an odd-lot quantity exactly as traded.
a15.lot.warn_buy: Note: the buy quantity is not a multiple of 100, so it may be rejected on submit.
a15.lot.warn_star: Note: STAR Market stocks need at least 200 shares per buy, so this may be rejected on submit.
